column38: Community to Site Management Committee Interface Meetings
column59:
A community meeting was held with the Site Management Committee (SMC) and IDPs to discuss winter preparedness, key needs, and ways to protect IDPs and their tents during the winter season.

The discussion focused on flooding risks and the need for sand and sandbags to protect tents from flooding and strong winds. The community highlighted the importance of providing these materials to improve the safety and stability of tents during winter.
